about: Our own libsodium build for the phone (replaces react-native-libsodium's prebuilt build.tgz). The source is libsodium's VERSIONED release tarball (immutable; the '-stable' tarball is re-rolled over time and would one day fail its pin), pinned by its SHA-256 AND verified with libsodium.org's minisign key; the build is reproducible with the pinned NDK, so each library's SHA-256 is pinned too. Built by scripts/build-libsodium-android.sh before every gradle build. Change the source or the NDK: rebuild with --print, review, and pin the new sums here.
